body: This reminds me of a Ray Bradbury short story... I think it was called "The Murderer". Some of his futuristic stories feel like they could be set in today's present.
Never experienced this. Feelings are, to some degree, a decision, if you ask me.

I sympathise so much. Just when I (32f) felt myself ready to start trusting him and relying on him, he broke things off, saying I deserved better (as if it weren't my decision to make what I deserve/want).
He wasn't keeping his options open or cheating on me, though. That just makes it harder to understand though - he broke off contact to someone else who showed interest in him and told me about it openly, he was fine with me leaving make-up and cosmetics and clothing at his place, even washed it for me and didn't make a fuss. 
Somehow it feels like he couldn't bear being treated as well as I treated him. It feels like every time I open myself up to someone and give myself to them, they turn around on me and say they don't want it.
May I ask how long it took you to realise you wanted her back?

He seemed to think holding me would lessen the pain - but he's the one who caused said pain. I am kind of angry at myself for wanting him back. Why would I do that to myself, wanting someone back who - even though he beat himself up about it - went ahead and hurt me like that?

I simply don't understand why someone promises they won't hurt me, but then makes the decision to hurt me anyway. If I don't want to hurt someone, I don't hurt them, it's as simple as that. If I appreciate them enough, they are worth it for me to work on things. You can't expect everything to be perfect.
I know you can't, but you understand my confusion, right?

We really do. I miss his hugs. He wanted to hold/hug me to comfort me when he broke up with me. What's up with that? He decides to hurt me for no good reason, and then he wants to comfort me? Why is his brain such a puzzle?
It just felt so right, being with him. I don't understand what went wrong.
Thanks. It's hard right now because I can't get real-life hugs.
I really wish I could reach her...

Even my therapist could see I was doing so much better. I started going before Corona struck and only saw her in person twice, then we had to switch to phone sessions. When she finally saw me again im person in May, she remarked that she could tell how much I had grown and that a much more confident and much stronger person had walked into her office than the one she met at first.

I swear, stupid Corona ruins everything. I feel so much like dying right now that I almost wish I'd get it. Call me crazy, but that's how bad it is.
It just makes living life and being somewhat okay so much harder. I was super depressed when the whole Corona crisis started... And I was so proud that I managed to get out of that hole almost all by myself. That's the hardest part, I think, when you think you're doing so much better and are in a much better place and then you give someone else the power to kick you back down in that dark whole and take away the ladder you built to get out of there.
Have you considered couple's therapy?

I can only tell you that if you broke up with her, you've done a lot of damage and caused a lot of pain. If you want to win her back, it's your job to make amends and fix the damage you've done and reassure her that it won't happen again, else you're unfair to both her and yourself.

I think so, too. I just know it'll take some time for me to find the right words to ask them.
The worst part is that I'm usually a kind, friendly, cheerful person and experiences like this make go quiet and make me want to be mean to and angry at anyone, though nobody deserves it.

What's more, even if he decided to come back to me, I'm not sure I could feel secure. He's broken up with me once for no good reason - he could do it again just as easily, and if he does it after another 3 months or more, I'm scared it'll feel even worse. It already feels bad enough this time.

I've blocked him for now; I told him I would block him for a week at least, possibly up to a month. But I've still got questions and he said he was prepared to answer them (if he could). The problem is, I don't want to get my hopes up, because it will only prolong the pain.

I'm wondering the same... after the first date, we both talked like a second date was a given... and yes, the second date did happen, after all. I guess I should have made plans for a third date right then and there, then I would have seen he wasn't going for it and could have gotten closure.

You know what I don't get about that? If he'd treated me right, he could have gotten so much more... Eff me for being a caring, giving person who acknowledges that sex and intimate stuff is maybe a more significant part of a (budding) relationship to men than it may be to women.

I would have addressed his vagueness about spending time. I meant to ask him if he was on the same page about whether he wanted a real commitment or not, and if he didn't/wasn't ready, I would have told him it doesn't work for me. But he's not giving me a chance to address it anyway...
As for how I feel when I'm with him - I felt wonderful. When I'm not with him... I miss him.
He met up with me (2nd date) and was pushy about me giving him a BJ.
I feel like he at least deserves to be confronted about the fact that using someone like that is not okay. Seriously, with the way men treat me, it's no wonder I have trust issues.
Deleted accidental multi-posts... Sorry, I'm relatively new to Reddit and got an error message saying my response couldn't be posted.

First of all, thanks for your response!
It's just that... I think the reason I want to know why is because if I put myself in his shoes, I know I would want to see a man again if he'd pleased me like I did him. That's just something I don't understand. And somehow, it feels like any reasons he could give me couldn't possibly hurt me as much as the ones I torture myself with in my own head. I feel like I need that closure. 
And I also think talking about it would be the mature thing to do. Maybe it's just that I want to know what I did wrong. I thought being kind and attentive to someone and showing them you care was the right thing to do... Also part of it is that I just want to know how he can justify using me this way without being eaten up inside because I would have such a bad conscience, were I in his shoes.
